map.按儿童月龄显示年龄线及以下的 96 项自评清单，勾选通过/未通过后统计各能区延迟: Show the age-line checklist for the child's age, mark pass/fail, then count delayed items per domain and show a screening hint.
map.📖 清单设计参考：Frankenburg WK, Dodds J, Archer: 📖 Design reference: Frankenburg WK, Dodds J, Archer P, Shapiro H, Bresnick B. The Denver II: a major revision and restandardization of the Denver Developmental Screening Test. Pediatrics. 1992;89(1):91-97. | This page is a simplified self-check: 4 domains × 12 age groups × 2 items = 96 items, showing the age line and lower plus the next two groups; it is not the full 125-item Denver II.
map.关于「DDST 发育筛查清单（简化版）」: About the DDST Developmental Screening Checklist (Simplified)
map.本页是简化自评清单，不替代专业筛查或诊断: This page is a simplified self-check and does not replace professional screening or diagnosis
map.按当前月龄自动划定年龄线: Automatically sets the age line from the current month age
map.年龄线及以下未测完时不给「正常」结论: No "normal" conclusion while age-line items remain untested
map.纯前端运行，数据不上传服务器: Runs entirely in the front end; no data is uploaded
map.本工具纯前端运行，数据不会上传到服务器: Runs entirely in the front end; no data is uploaded to any server
map.本页为简化自评清单（96 项），不是 Denver II 完整 125 项标准化: This page is a 96-item simplified checklist, not the full 125-item Denver II, and does not replace professional screening or diagnosis
map.判定阈值仅为本页提示线，结果请结合专业评估: Thresholds are hints for this page only; combine results with professional assessment
map.年龄线及以下无未通过，且年龄线及以下全部已测: No failures at or below the age line, and all age-line items tested
map.年龄线及以下有 1 项未通过: 1 failure at or below the age line
map.年龄线及以下有 ≥2 项未通过: ≥2 failures at or below the age line
map.年龄线及以下尚有项目未标记: Some age-line items are still unmarked
map.补测后再判读: Complete the missing items before interpreting
map.提示：本页是简化自评清单（96 项），不是 Denver II 完整 125 项: Note: this page is a 96-item simplified self-check, not the full 125-item Denver II; the thresholds are hints for this page only and are neither a positive screen nor a diagnosis. Items at or below the age line are things the child should already do, and only failures there count as delays; failures on harder items to the right of the line do not count. Preterm infants may be assessed by corrected age until 2 years. If several delays appear or the parent remains concerned, seek a standardized assessment in child health or developmental-behavioural care.
map.📚 深度解析：DDST 发育筛查清单（简化版）: 📚 Deep dive: DDST Developmental Screening Checklist (Simplified)
map.儿保体检前，家长按年龄线逐项自评并记录未通过项: Before a child-health visit, parents self-check item by item along the age line and record failures
map.语言、运动等里程碑的粗筛记录，便于就诊时描述: A rough screening record of language and motor milestones to describe at the visit
map.转诊前整理「哪些项目未通过」，供专业人员参考: List which items failed before referral for professionals to review
map.年龄线及以下 2 项未通过 → 语言能区异常 → 总体异常，建议转诊发育评估；本: Two failures at or below the age line -> language domain abnormal -> overall abnormal; refer for developmental assessment. This page does not require a "repeat until normal" step before referral.
map.各能区延迟项为 0 且无未测项 → 正常；判定看的是延迟项数量，不是通过率百分比: Zero delays and no untested items -> normal; the judgement uses the number of delayed items, not a pass-rate percentage. Routine check-up follow-up is enough.
map.个人-社交、精细动作-适应性、语言、大运动四个能区；本页按能区分别统计年龄线及以: Four domains: personal-social, fine motor-adaptive, language and gross motor; this page counts age-line and lower failures separately for each.
map.本页是简化自评清单（96 项），不是 Denver II 完整 125 项标准化: This page is a 96-item simplified self-check, not the full 125-item Denver II. If results are abnormal or the parent remains concerned, seek a standardized assessment in child health or developmental-behavioural care.
map.年龄线及以下仍有项目未标记通过/未通过时，本页不给「正常」结论，先补测再判读。: While age-line items remain unmarked, this page does not conclude "normal"; complete them before interpreting.
map.矫正胎龄 (周，早产儿填写): Corrected gestational age (weeks, for preterm infants)
